verdict.rationale: Stripe Tax documents worldwide VAT/GST calculation, returns tax data through its calculation API, and stores tax registrations via the Dashboard or Tax Registrations API, so VAT data can flow into invoicing. A beta user reports VAT handling driven by customer address and VAT numbers. However, no evidence shows invoices themselves carrying the required VAT fields, seller or buyer registration numbers, or locale-specific invoice rules, and community notes that VIES VAT-number validation runs only once. Missing for 10: documented invoice-level VAT field and registration-number rendering, locale-specific invoice compliance rules, re-validation of customer VAT numbers, independent hands-on corroboration of compliant invoice output.

support.subject: As an ops user, invoices come out compliant where I sell — required VAT fields, registration numbers, and locale rules flow through to my invoicing system or are generated by the product itself

citations.quote: Calculate sales tax, VAT, and GST for transactions worldwide, determining tax rates based on product type, customer location, and business location.
add your registrations to Stripe using the Locations tab in the Dashboard or Tax Registrations API
Stripe tax does all of that automatically, based on the customer full address and VAT numbers.
Itemized exports contain a detailed view of the line item level tax breakdown for every transaction.
